title: Talented Rueben Bain Jr., Akheem Mesidor expected to make NFL draft splash — but some questions loom

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Talented Rueben Bain Jr., Akheem Mesidor expected to make NFL draft splash — but some questions loom
sources.description: Indiana quarterback Fernando Mendoza was the biggest star of the College Football Playoffs. But just behind him were a pair of Miami edge rushers who sacked Mendoza three times in the championship game and wreaked havoc during the entire playoffs.
